description: Test suite for allowlist configuration editing functions related to a plugin SDK. It includes tests for reading and processing allowlist entries, collecting overrides from records (including nested structures), and building allowlist adapters for different account configurations. Uses Vitest for testing and imports various functions from 'allowlist-config-edit.js'.

methods.name: readConfiguredAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Processes an array of entries, coercing mixed types into non-empty strings, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: collectAllowlistOverridesFromRecord
methods.description: Collects non-empty allowlist entries from a flat record structure based on provided accessors.

methods.name: collectNestedAllowlistOverridesFromRecord
methods.description: Traverses a hierarchical record to gather allowlist overrides from outer and nested levels.

methods.name: createFlatAllowlistOverrideResolver
methods.description: Constructs a resolver for flat account override records, resolving entries within account data.

methods.name: createNestedAllowlistOverrideResolver
methods.description: Builds a resolver for nested account override records involving hierarchical structures.

methods.name: createAccountScopedAllowlistNameResolver
methods.description: Creates a name resolver function scoped to an account token, resolving entries to names.

methods.name: buildDmGroupAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds an adapter for managing allowlist configurations for DM/group accounts, with support for reading and applying config edits.

methods.name: buildLegacyDmAccountAllowlistAdapter
methods.description: Builds a legacy adapter for DM account allowlist configurations, with simplified behavior.

ctags.name: scopeCases
ctags.pattern: /^  const scopeCases: Array<{ scope: "dm" | "group" | "all"; expected: boolean }> = [$/
